nom: belif Aqua Bomb Lifting Eye Gel

avis.texte: This eye gel is very lightweight and absorbs quickly without feeling sticky. It instantly makes my under-eye area feel refreshed and hydrated. I especially love using it in the morning – it helps reduce puffiness and gives a smoother look under makeup. The cooling effect is very приятный, and it doesn't irritate my sensitive skin, which is very important for me. After using it for a while, I noticed my under-eye area looks more awake and less tired. I would definitely buy it again!

avis.titre: Okay to have but not magic.
avis.texte: I like the cool feel of this, but don't think it necessarily makes a big difference.

avis.titre: Not great on its own or under makeup
avis.texte: I had high hopes for this undereye cream, given that it came pretty highly recommended. I love the texture and the smell is nice, and the applicator is also great. However the product itself is somewhat disappointing. I put it on in the morning and apply concealer on top (I set my concealer with a powder) and I still find that it does not sit well under the concealer, my fine lines start peeking through pretty quickly. Additionally, when I use it without applying concealer after, it remains tacky and sticky all day and doesn't feel like it's actually absorbing into the skin.

I just tried this product for the first time. I was confused about the purpose of the applicator, I felt it was easier to just use my finger. After using it a few times, I get it- It's like a cooling massage for your under-eyes. The product itself is great. I find that the gel products don't absorb into my skin as much, so there's a residue that's left behind. This one absorbs pretty well.

I use this in the morning to plump up my undereye area and reduce the appearance of bags and shadows. Love the cooling applicator. A little product goes a long way. There are no miracle creams but this does noticeably help and provides a good base for a bit of concealer.
Feels so silky under my eyes. Definitely helps with the eye bags.

I really like this eye treatment. It showed me what my eyes truly need. A serum like moisturizer that glides on and plumps my under eye. This Belif eye treatment does all the heavy work for me at night. It firms and lifts. I wake up looking well-rested. My lines are less visible and my hollowness slightly restored. I use a vitamin C eye treatment during the day to protect all the work this one put in. Great for sensitive skin!

I have a stubborn bag under one of my eyes that's been there for about a year. Some remedies had helped temporarily, but nothing had sustained. After about 3 weeks of using this eye cream day and night, I really do see a noticeable and substantial difference. I'm so happy because I thought it was a lost cause and that I would never find anything that would actually help

The product itself is lovely, smooth and feels great. The applicator has zero metering. You might get a little bit, you might get a huge glob. I've tried varying the pressure on the dispenser, but it is so random. The gel doesn't absorb quickly either, so it's kind of shiny and sticky for a while. It's nice enough that I'll use it up, just not sure I'll reorder.

I thought this was great the first day, moisturizing and cooling! But as the days passed my undereye area broke out into itchy bumps. My inner and outer corners are flaky and super dry! It stung after around three days and I gave it a week to improve. It got worse! Returned asap.

I've used aqua bomb for a long time and was excited to try this product. But it dries and creates a weird thin shiny film around my eyes that peeled throughout the day. Used it once, returned the next day. Big thumbs down.

avis.titre: Easy to use and make part of your skin care routine!
avis.texte: I used this morning and night - the applicator made it so easy to use!!
Smells so and seems to help with firming and giving a lifted look!

There are so many things I love about this product! I love the design - the cooling applicator tip feels great and also helps prevent applying too much pressure with your fingers. It smells amazing! It also keeps my under eye moisturized. I received this product for free in exchange for my honest opinion.

avis.titre: I will definitely buy this again
avis.texte: I am so impressed with this product. I used it for two weeks and can definitely see the difference under my eyes. It has a lighter consistency than similar brands but works so good! Definitely try this one it's a keeper.
It's so cooling and refreshing when you apply it. I haven't used it long enough to know but the ingredients is beneficial.
Love this product. Works wonders and makes you look refreshed and awake. It's nice that it has an easy to use applicator, so you don't have to use your fingers. Will buy again.

I really enjoyed using this eye gel. The formula is great, it has helped with lifting, hydrating and making my under eyes look refreshed . The applicator is convinient so I don't have to use my fingers. Just a tiny bit of product goes a long way.

avis.titre: Nice addition to my AM routine
avis.texte: I received this to test and share my opinion. It was sent to me about 2 weeks ago, and i have been using it daily. I use it as my eye cream every morning. I like the applicator and how the formula feels on my skin. It's s easy to apply and is quick to smooth in and absorb into my eye area. I honestly dont notice a difference in my eye area appearance but I feel it is a good daily treatment and a welcome preventative product in my daily routine.

I used this after washing my face, usually in the morning but sometimes at night as well. I used it like I use all my eye creams. Put this on first and then my serum and moisturizer. I like the little pump and that it comes with an applicator as well. It makes it really easy to smooth it into your skin but also get in the crevices. I don't know why but aqua bomb made me think it was be a blue gel, but it's a beige lotion. Anyway it wasn't irritating to the skin at all. I don't really know how well it worked though. One day I only used it on one under eye and I really didn't see a difference with it looking for lifted or awake.

First and foremost I LOVE the applicator on this. It's so convenient to not have to use my fingers. Second, I love the way this feels on my skin, it's lifting but keeps my under eye moisturized. As far as lift goes, I have noticed a slight difference in brightness and I look more awake when I use this product. I'll be keeping this in my rotation!

avis.titre: It Works Wonders – Even My Boyfriend Approved and Loves It!
avis.texte: This product is amazing! ✨ It really made a noticeable difference in the appearance of my eyes, they look so much brighter and refreshed. The best part? My boyfriend, who had pretty big under-eye bags and a tired look, tried it too. I wish I had taken before-and-after photos because the results were incredible! He was so impressed that he's using it all the time now (and I can't stop laughing about it 🤭). We both highly recommend this product. It truly works!
I'm in love with this aqua bomb lifting eye gel, I received it and in return I would give my honest review, it helps my under eyes feel so refreshed and relaxed I feel better about my appearance.

I received this product free from BzzAgent and LGBeauty Belif in exchange for my honest review. I immediately started using the Belif Aqua Bomb eye lifting Gel upon receiving. It's been about three weeks of continuous use morning and night. I apply the product under my eye, around my entire eye area and forehead. Using the applicator tip is extremely effective. Leftover product I gently tap into my skin, it absorbs effortlessly. This product leaves my skin feeling refreshed and rejuvenated. My skin is glossy and glowing after every application. Aqua Bomb eye lifting gel has marvelous ingredients, that help to keep your skin looking and feeling years younger. Retinol, collagen and Bakchoil help support your skins structure and strengths elasticity in it. Peptides also help your skins resilience and keeps it supple. Compared to other eye lifting products on the market now, the Aqua Bomb lifting Gel is top tier. However, the MSRP is a bit steep when other products contain the same ingredients. I definitely recommend giving it a try to see results for yourself. I probably won't purchase after finishing the month supply.

I've been using this eye gel for the past 2 weeks and it's very moisturizing. I wouldn't say I noticed any lifting but the sensitive skin around my eyes are moisturized. When applied, the product absorbed quickly and there is a very cooling feeling, which is nice. The applicator is unique and doesn't require me to touch the gel with my fingers.
I appreciate the clean ingredients. This eye gel is cooling, depuffing, and hydrating. I love the lightweight non-greasy formula. I wear contacts so this is great for sensitive eyes like mine.

avis.titre: Cool applicator for this eye gel
avis.texte: The applicator is unique and makes the product novel. However, I felt a little too much product came out when pressing down. The formula is pretty nice, not greasy. Blended in nicely and my undereyes felt a little tighter and "lifted" after a few minutes. Not a huge fan of the smell because it was a little too perfume-y to be right around my eyes.

avis.titre: Wrinkles? What Wrinkles? belif Aqua Bomb Lifting Eye Gel Del
avis.texte: I received the belif Aqua Bomb Lifting Eye Gel in exchange for my honest review, and I can honestly say it lives up to its name. The lightweight gel absorbs quickly, yet delivers noticeable firming around the delicate eye area. Within just a short time, I saw fine lines under my eyes start to soften. The skin feels smoother, more lifted, and less tired-looking. The best part? When I asked my daughter if the wrinkles under my eyes looked any better, she responded with, "What wrinkles?" That alone tells me this eye gel is working. If you're looking for something that hydrates, firms, and visibly minimizes fine lines without being heavy or greasy, this is absolutely worth trying.
Feels light and smooth upon upon application and absorbs nicely

I absolutely love this eye gel. I'm not normally a gel gal because I have dry skin and like rich moisturizing products. However, I was pleasantly surprised when I tried the Aqua Bomb Lifting Eye Gel. First of all, the applicator is phenomenal. It keeps your fingers from contaminating the product and it feels so soothing on the under eyes! It is also shaped so perfectly for the area right above the orbital bone, allowing you to get all way into the inner corners of the eye. I only use half a pump (too much product comes out with a full pump) and dab little dots around my eyes, then use the cool applicator to smooth the gel onto my undereyes. It helps my puffiness immediately because of the cool touch applicator. It sinks in quickly and is incredibly moisturizing both at the moment of use and over time. As to the lifting claim, I have not been using it enough to see that effect yet. The smell is light and pleasant and not overpowering. I would recommend this eye gel to anyone who likes a pick me up under their eyes in the morning. Tip: keep it in the fridge for an extra cooling effect! I was gifted this product in exchange for my honest review.
I have been applying the Aqua bomb lifting eye gel at night for two weeks now & even after one night I noticed a drastic improvment.

avis.titre: Awesome eye skincare that firms and lifts!
avis.texte: Belif products are the best! Truly the best skin care products! Easily glides on skin with smooth tip applicator! Firms and lifts the skin around your eyes.

avis.titre: Love it and will be buying it again
avis.texte: I've been using this product for two weeks now, its not an overnight miracle. But it's pretty darn awesome, I am 37 and definitely see some difference, I've been using around my eyes(upper and lower) at night and just under during the day. I have a bit of sag now in my upper kids. I would describe two weeks of daily use so far, amazing; my eyes aren't dramatically different but they have an overall more "opened up", maybe refreshed look? I'm happy, I'm excited to keep using and see where we go from here. I love this brand too, it's affordable and luxury quality.

avis.titre: More of a cream than a gel
avis.texte: The firmness is noticeable, but not as pronounced as similar products. There is scent, sort of minty, that I had to adjust too and use the product a little further away from my eye. It is non-greasy. One pump is enough for both eyes. I received this item for free for my honest review. I'm not sure if I would purchase this product.
I love the applicator on this and how easy it is to distribute the product , also the product feels sooooo good underneath the eyes!

I really love the Aqua Bomb lifting eye gel. It soaks into my skin quickly and leaves my eyes looking younger and refreshes. My eyes can be kind of sensitive and this product doesn't make them sting and doesn't leave the delicate skinny around my eyes irritated. Highly recommend to anyone who wants bright beautiful eyes!

I was given this product for free to try in exchange for an honest review. I was very excited to try this mostly due to some of the ingredients it contained. Most intriguing was bakuchiol. I've heard good things about how this helps improve skin. First impression upon receiving the product was I liked the pretty pink packaging and the unique applicator tip on the product. The print on the packaging was very small and being 51, I had a hard time reading the label and directions. Nevertheless, I applied the product to my undereyes and lids in the morning and at night. Turns out the applicator I was so excited about wasn't really as fubctional as I had hoped. I ended up just using a clean finger to smooth the product out. It felt good on my skin and was perfect under my makeup even in the undereye area. 4 days in, I developed a stye and had to discontinue use for a few days until it resolved. After that I continued to use the product for a couple more days and developed another stye. I'm still using the product in hopes of seeing improvement in dark circles and fine lines, but I'm very careful not to get it too close to my lash line. Other than the styes, I haven't really noticed any other changes positive or negative. I probably wouldn't recommend this only because of the stye development, which I can say I've never had issues with before.

I absolutely love the applicator on the eye gel and how perfectly it blends into my undereyes. I have noticed my skin looks softer when using it consistently. It really helps smooth out all the fine lines.

First let me say that I love the applicator on this! My eyes truly benefit from the coolness & smoothness of it; it's also more sanitary as you don't have to use your fingers. It has only been about 2 weeks since I started using it so I can't TRULY speak on its effectiveness quite yet. Do I like the applicator? Absolutely! Do I like the application? Absolutely!

avis.titre: Too soon to tell a difference but has potential
avis.texte: I have been using this product for just at two weeks now. I use it at night after I was my face and before I go to bed. To be honest, not much difference on the first week. However, I think this week things are starting to look a little less droopy around the eyes. There is zero change in the bags and circles, but the lines and creases seem to be less shocking. I think this product has potential, but it definitely takes time and patience and consistent use. Overall, I would keep using it.

I have been using this lifting eye gel for two weeks and really enjoy the results. The applicator is refreshingly cool every time I apply the gel to my eye area. The pump is easy to dispense although I full pump dispenses too much gel. I would recommend only a half pump for both eyes. The cooling applicator quickly reduces puffiness and as the product dries it lightly lifts the area under my eye. The eye gel also has a light pleasant fragrance and absorbs quickly.

This product feels really nice and refreshing on my under eyes. The one thing I wish was a little different was the way the cream comes out. If it had a push button on the bottom or like a roller on the side it would be a little better. Overall I do enjoy this on my eyes and would purchase and recommend to my friends and family. It feels really soft compared to other products that feel oily. This one is not its like a buttery soft but not greasy. The way the applicator feels is amazing its a perfect curve to get right under you eye how the angle is to get as close as possible with the corners.

I recently tried this belief aqua bomb lifting eye gel and I loved how it improved the appearance of my eyes. I also like that it comes with an applicator spatula looking like and it awesome because you can use it to massage it on your eyes fine lines/wrinkles.

I've used this for about two weeks and I love it! The applicator is so good. Helps the product go on so smoothly and it feels cooling for a bit. I wish the applicator stayed cooler for longer. The cream itself is silky and feels great under makeup. It has some fragrance to it but not too bad. I wouldn't say I've seen great difference but I do feel like my under eyes are more hydrated. I received this product for free for a honest review!

As someone who is starting to age, I want to take better care of my skin. I have noticed that there are some fine lines starting to appear around my eyes, and the bags under my eyes are becoming more prominent. The Belief Aqua Bomb Lifting Eye Gel has been a game changer. First, I love the texture of this cream. A little goes a long way. I use about one whole pump for both of my eyes. I usually dot the cream around my eyes first, and then I use the ceramic applicator to gently work the cream into the skin. Let me tell you, that applicator is magic. I love the way it feels under my eyes, as the ceramic is cold and provides a refreshing feeling. I have been using this product for several weeks now, and I will continue to do so. I really feel like it is adding a step to my routine that I didn't really have before, and that while the differences aren't life changing, I can definitely see some relief from the bagginess, and I know that my skin isn't getting worse!

I LOVE Belif products and was so excited to try this eye gel! Happy to say it's another great product from the brand. I work night shift and struggle with dark bags under my eyes often due to lack of sleep. I love how this product added a lifting and brightening effect that made me look more alert and awake. It blends really well with other product so no creases that often happens with eye products. Definitely a must have if you suffer from under eye problems!

I liked the texture of the product, it absorbed fairly quickly and didn't leave a greasy finish. The dispenser was simple to use and I was able to control how much product came out (it didn't waste product). I didn't use any concealer so I can't say how it works under that, but it worked well with sunscreen. I usually have some bagginess in the morning and this helps soften it. Overall, I liked it as an eye cream; it was gentle around my eyes (no tearing or stinging) and would recommend it to friends.

I enjoyed the brief cooling sensation and the pleasant scent when applied, however, I did not notice and firming or alleviating dark circles. It only absorbs well when using fingers and not the applicator. There has been no improvement to dark circles, puffiness, or wrinkles that I have noticed after daily use.

This is my new favorite eye cream! I use it both morning and night. After cleansing my face in the morning I apply this before applying my makeup, my eye area appears firmer and lifted. I highly recommend Aqua Bomb eye gel. It's not heavy but not too light or thin either (if that makes sense)

I started use on 8/19, I believe this has helped to reduce dark circles and remove some puffiness. This has amazing moisturizing properties and it feels so good to put it on everyday. I used my fingers to place it and then use the ceramic applicator to massage. On the Pic, the top is the day I started, 2nd is on 9/1, 3rd is day I started while smiling, and last is 9/1.

I received this product as part of a promotion. I have used eye creams before so I was a little skeptical when I tried the product. I thought the applicator was very practical. Previous eye creams I tried didn't have an applicator. I didn't expect the product to have a scent but it was very refreshing, At first I thought the product was greasy but it quickly absorbed and felt very moisturizing. Overall this is a great product that I will continue to use and recommend to others!
I like the packaging. The tip is so cooling to the eyes. The product is so good. It makes my under eyes soft and plump. I recommend

I work early morning so Belif Aqua bomb gel has helped me look more awake . I love how the formula is kind enough for me to use around my sensitive skin . The only improvement that I suggest would be to make the tip metal for an added cooling effect .

I recieved this product in exchange for an honest review. I love this Aqua Bomb Lifting Eye Gel! The product has nice smooth texture, not sticky at all. I have using for a few weeks now and have noticed a change in the puffy circles under my eyes, the puffiness is reduced and visibly brighter. I also love the built-in applicator, which makes for mess/germ free application. I definitely recommend this and would buy again.

avis.titre: Not as good as the competition
avis.texte: I used this a few times but did not experience any tightening or firming sensation. It left a greasy residue under my eyes that was hard to put make up over. Would definitely recommend the Peter Thomas Roth one instead

avis.titre: I would most def buy this again
avis.texte: I've been using this for about a month now and wow you can see a difference! My undereyes are so much brighter. I'm 26 and have been investing in skin care and this was well worth it!

Aqua Bomb Lifting Eye Gel is lightweight and feels instantly cooling thanks to its ceramic-tip applicator. It absorbs quickly without leaving residue, making it easy to layer under makeup. After a couple weeks of use, I noticed my under-eye area looked more awake and smoother. The formula is hydrating without being greasy and gentle despite containing retinol and peptides. While the lifting it gives a refreshed look that makes a difference in the mornings. Overall, a solid eye gel for hydration and a subtle firming boost.

I use the eye gel after washing my face at the end of the day. The ceramic applicator is big enough that I don't have to go over the eye area too many times. Very luxurious and cooling design. Big fan of the pump dispenser instead of a squeeze or twist mechanism to dispense product. Waiting to see results after consistent use.

I really wanted to love this product, but unfortunately it just isn't for me. I did enjoy the brief cooling sensation upon application and the fresh, pleasant scent. However, within minutes my eye area became itchy and uncomfortable, and I ultimately had to wash it off. Sadly, this one just didn't work for my skin.

I have now been using this day and night for almost two weeks. I love how this absorbs into my skin without feeling heavy or greasy. I have combo skin with oily t-zones predominantly. Eye creams can be tricky for me. Especially as im getting older fighting aging skin with fine lines. This gel/cream leaves my under eyes feeling nice and hydrated. There is a very faint hint of fragrance that im picking up but it goes away as quick as you smell it. I use one full pump between both sides and do light tapping it in. I think im going to definitely keep this permanently in my skincare routine. I would absolutely recommend this to anyone!

I began using this along with my regular moisturizer in the mornings. I let it sit for a few minutes while doing other tasks, and it does a great job of depuffing parts of my undereye area. I especially love the applicator shape because it makes it easy to apply.

This product is amazing and the experience and results are awesome! I love the ceramic tip and I always use it to message and depuff. The eye gel melts into skin right away, and I have noticed it helps depuff and hydrate. My under-eye area looks firmer and pumped. One of the best eye products i ever used!

I would apply this product every morning to a clean face and after moisturizing. I saw a difference almost immediately, I have been trying to product now for 7 days, and have even been complimented more since using this product! A little bit of the product goes a long way! I will be purchasing this product again!
This product is very moisturizing and does seem to help with fine lines. I love how cooling the applicator is and makes me feel so awake and refreshed!

belief kindly gifted me this product so I could review it. The sample arrived in cute pink packaging. The tube is easy to use and the built in applicator is really nice. The applicator stays cool and works well to apply the product. The eye gel has a nice scent and consistency but takes a while to absorb into the skin. While I've only been using for a couple of weeks, I have not observed any lifting or firming in the eye area. I will continue to use in hopes of noticing a difference.

I love this one! The consistency is creamy, smooth and thin, it doesn't feel greasy. There is a pump that dispenses the product and the applicator feels really cold and refreshing to touch. The smell is plesant and the product gets absorbed quickly so I am able to comfortable wear it under makeup. I do feel like it made a positive difference in how my fine lines and dark circles looked as well! Over all, I would definitely repurchase.

avis.titre: It is great as an under eye prep for foundation and conceale
avis.texte: I definitely would not say that does any firming or lifting, but it is a very good prep and prime for under the eye

I really like this eye serum! I've honestly seen subtle improvements since I began using it. The product has a refreshing cooling feeling while applying and I like the applicator tip. They only thing I think could be improved is the lids. It snaps on verses screwing, which can can lead it to pop off in a makeup case or while traveling.

This product works wonders for my eyes. The dispens is very unique and works beautifully. Works great for dark circles, eye bags and my wrinkles. The moisture it gives my eyes are endless. Wonderful product and I highly recommend it.

The dispenser is so cool! With an easy pump a perfect drop of gel comes out. Application feels soothing as the gel is applied, it cools and moisturizes the delicate under eye area. Fine lines seems to appear minimized after a couple of weeks of use. I'll continue to use it for sure!

This Aqua Bomb lifting eye gel is superb. It has exceeded my expectations. It comes in an easy to use applicator. it glides on. It has visibly improved the appearance of fine lines around my eyes. The skin is now hydrated, firm, and lifted. I am very happy.

I received a free sample of the Aqua Bomb Lifting Eye Gel through the BzzAgent sampling program in exchange for a review. I really enjoyed using this product as it worked pretty well for lifting and erasing my fine lines around the eyes. The applicator was nice and felt good using it. The cream itself smelled nice, absorbed easily, and didn't leave my skin feeling tight which has happened with other like products I have tried in the past. Compared to other eye lifting products I've used, this is one that I would purchase in the future.

I used the Aqua Bomb eye lifting gel in the evening after washing my face. I really think the ceramic tip applicator worked really well to help spread the product without pulling on my skin. I liked how the product absorbs into the skin and felt very light weight. I was impressed with how my pores seem smaller and how my under eye area does look tighter after using for a week. The scent took a little time to get used to especially as it has rosemary in the formula. But the scent does eventually go away. I can live with the scent especially since it helped get rid of the under eye bags I had.

avis.titre: No time for eye patches, use this!!
avis.texte: I've been using the Aqua Bomb Lifting Eye Gel for just over a week, and I'm already impressed! The cooling sensation is so refreshing and instantly soothing. It noticeably reduces puffiness, softens fine lines, and brightens up dark circles. On busy days when I don't have time for eye patches, this gel is the perfect quick fix—just a few seconds on each eye and the results speak for themselves. Highly recommend!
This eye serum is really light and goes on quickly. It absorbs well and does not leave a film of thickness. I think it helps with my fine lines and refreshes my skin before my makeup routine.
I really like this product. I do think it helps with lifting the area under my eyes. The dispenser is a little odd but other than that I would recommend it.
I love the way it dispenses and how cool it is in the mornings! It helps brighten around my eyes and makes my dark circles a little less dark.

The amount of moisture this brings is incredible. I have been struggling with dry skin around my eyes but haven't found a product that worked well and didn't leave me feeling greasy. This took care of that! Applicator is perfect and my skin is firm and hydrated. Love this product.
I am 60 and have dark circles and extremely dry skin. This is the first product that has helped. I love how I can use concealer now without it getting in all my crevices.

I received this product free of charge for an honest review. The product is easy to apply. Just remove the cap, press the pump and the cream comes out onto the applicator. Its called a gel but is really a cream. The instructions say to massage under and around eyes. I did just that and waited 20 minutes. I did not see any difference after 20 minutes. I saw a slight difference 12 hours later at the end of the day but it is not a product I would go out and purchase.

I really love this eye gel! It leaves my under eye area moisturized, brightened, and taut. I love the applicator because the product stays hygienic and it makes it easy to use. It looks great under makeup and doesn't crease or crack my foundation/concealer. Sometimes I get milia from eye cream products but this hasn't been a problem for me at all using it because it is so lightweight. I also like that I don't have to use much of the product. I highly recommend it!

This product comes easy to use. It is so simple lotion goes on nice and smooth. It helps the puffiness under your eyes it last all day. The lotion is not oily. It doesn't leave a residue. It makes your skin extremely soft. I definitely would buy this and recommend this product

Belif sent me this free sample through the BzzAgent sampling program. This is a beautiful glowy eye gel. Very easy to apply since it dispenses from the tube and applies with the cooling wand (which feels great first thing in the morning) My fine lines seem to disappear once applied and I'm left with a glow. Ok to apply under makeup, just allow time for it to set. I have very sensitive eyes and had no issues with this product. I've tried a lot of eye creams that are thick or irritating but this is neither of those. No need to use a lot so it should last a while. I will definitely purchase this product again.

I was sent this product for free in exchange for a review and I have to say at first I wasn't sure if it would do anything but after a couple weeks it's definitely added to my routine!!! I love the applicator and how easy it is to use. I was worried about it laying funny and pilling under my makeup but it didn't at all! In fact, this creasing concealer that I could not get to look right looked so good with this product under it which sold me! My under eyes looked moisturized, brighter and lifted. My skin is sometimes sensitive under the eyes and this product did not have any burning or stinging so that is amazing!

This eye gel is lovely with its light scent and airy texture. It absorbs quickly, spreads easily around the delicate eye area, and doesn't leave any sticky residue. The packaging design is harmonious, with soft, cute colors that make it feel fresh and elegant. It gives a refreshing feeling upon application—definitely a nice addition to a skincare routine. Taking one star off only because the lifting effect takes time to notice, but overall it's a very pleasant product to use.

avis.titre: Great eye cream for aging eyes
avis.texte: I was given this product in exchange for my honest review and I'm really happy I was able to try it! I think this is a nice hydrating eye cream that is even good for use on the eye lid in the morning before makeup. I haven't had any issues with applying eyeshadow over it. It has helped my fine lines around my eyes. I especially love the metal applicator since it gives the added benefit of instantly de-puffing my under eye bags in the morning. I will be buying this again!
I received this product for free. I decided to put it in my fridge so that it gives an extra cooling factor. This product makes your under eyes feeling and looking so refreshed.

I've been trying my best to use this at least once a day since I got it, but I'm not sure this is doing much to report on so far. Initially, it does seem to brighten my eyes as it claims, I'm not sure if brightening is the same thing as alleviating dark circles - it definitely doesn't help with dark circles , but I do feel it kinda "lifts" my eyes a little, which it also claims. I do not like the way it smells though. But application is easy, a little goes along way, and it feels so nice as it glides across your eyes. All in all, it does what it claims at least somewhat initially- maybe longer term I'll see more promising results, but as of right now, I'm not sure I'd buy this product.

avis.titre: This product is decent but not the best that I've tried
avis.texte: Belif sent me this free sample through the BzzAgent sampling program of their Aqua Bomb Lifting Eye Gel. First off, the applicator is smooth and glides fine product on very nicely. However, it doesn't absorb into the skin unless you use your fingertips. The smell is clean, reminds me of a soap smell. The product does not burn and is even kind of cooling. I've used this product for a week now and I have not noticed any dramatic improvement in the fine lines under my eyes. I will continue to use the rest of the product every day to see if I notice any improvements in my under eye area. My recommendation is to only depress the applicator half way when applying. When pressed all the way down, it releases too much product.

avis.titre: I have been looking for the perfect eye cream a long time!
avis.texte: I've only been using this eye cream for about a month, but I can already tell you this is the product and packaging of my dreams. The cream absorbs fast and isn't greasy, so it's perfect under makeup or on it's own. It has a light almost citrus scent which isn't perfumey or overpowering. The texture of this is really the best part, it's light but feels nourishing and it is so cool and refreshing under the eyes. Huge honorable mention to the applicator. I was sent this product for review, but I will never be without it again, cannot recommend this enough.

avis.titre: Lifting the eyes with a catch!
avis.texte: This product is honestly pretty amazing! I started noticing results within just three days, even if they were subtle at first. My only complaint is that I naturally have oily skin, and the aqua/liquid texture of this product doesn't really help control that. I usually apply it early in the morning to let it set and work its magic, then follow up with a mattifier to manage the excess oil.

I don't dislike this product but also haven't noticed much benefit. The product goes on smoothly, makes a nice base for my concealer, and the massaging tip feels nice on tired eyes. It might be too soon to tell but there has been zero improvement to dark circles, puffiness, or wrinkles and the product doesn't 100% absorb when using the massaging tip so I have to blot it off after applying. Feels nice going on but I wouldn't purchase.

avis.titre: Such an amazing product! Will be purchasing again!
avis.texte: I love this eye gel! The packaging is super durable, and the ceramic applicator is AMAZING. It provides a cooling effect and applies the product evenly and smoothly. The gel itself absorbs so quickly, and when it dries you can't even tell you put it on. I can see results almost immediately.

I really enjoyed using the Belif Aqua Bomb Lifting Eye Gel, that I received for free in exchange for writing a review. First off, it actually works well!! I like the smoothness and creaminess of the product, I like the little tube it's in that way it's easier to apply to the under eye, you don't even have to apply it with your fingertips, unless you like. I also enjoy that it has somewhat of a natural lemony smell. The cream does feel thick but once it's dissolved it doesn't feel heavy under the eyes, love that! I would definitely recommend and will be repurchasing!

Okay, I know we all hear of products that claim to work miracles and never do. I will definitely be purchasing this lifting eye gel as soon as mine runs out. I have bags and dark circles no matter how much sleep I get. The very first time I tried this product I was amazed at the results. I have been searching for an eye cream that helps with the puffy under eye area that is also hydrating. I have really sensitive skin especially around my eyes. In the past it has been really easy for me to get chemical burns so i was skeptical. I am hydrated, de-puffed and looking my best. I will 100% be purchasing when its time..this is a holy grail AMAZING product!!

The aqua bomb lifting eye gel was amazing! The applicator was so unique and felt cooling and soothing on my dry skin. I would purchase a million times over. My concealer looked better than ever and my eyes stayed moisturized all day. I highly recommend anyone try this- dry under eyes or not, it's truly a luxury feeling experience!

avis.titre: Good product, packaging could use work
avis.texte: I think this eye cream was great! Not too thick or thin, has a pleasant scent, I like how the applicator feels under my eyes. The only issue I had (and maybe it was user error) was that there wasn't an easy way to dispense the cream. You push down on it to dispense which either means you're pushing down on the sensitive undereye skin or using your fingers. I think a clickable or squeezable design would be more user friendly.

I use this product each morning as part of my facial cleaning regimen. I shower and then apply right away. The ceramic applicator provides a nice cooling experience in the application which I greatly enjoyed. The feeling left on my eyes after application does include some tightening, but overly so. Clearly, under my eyes is great moisturizing effect. Lift? Hard to say definitively, but I am liking the results. The worst I can say about the product is the type on the packaging, which is almost unreadable it is so small.

avis.titre: This product is great! Love it!
avis.texte: I have used this product morning and night since receiving it. I LOVE the applicator and the click/pump system to get the product on the applicator. I have noticed a decrease in puffiness and tiredness around my eyes. It has a light scent, but nothing obnoxious. I would purchase this product again once I run out.
I loved this eye gel! I have sensitive skin and it was hydrating without irritating my sensitive under eye area!
It worked really well and I love the applicator tip that you use to sculp your lift in the direction you want doesn't last all day but good before a beat

avis.titre: Feels plumper and definitely more moisturized
avis.texte: I've been using this eye gel for about 5 days now and I can say I have noticed that my eye "bags" are less intense - they look more plump! I have always had some bags due to work and stress so finding a product that fills them in realistically is nice. I love the moisture that it brings and the applicator is so easy to work with. It keeps you from dragging the skin and it's soft to the touch. I really like the applicator.

This is a great eye lifter. I can definitely feel that it moisturized my under eyes really well. My only complaint is the applicator. It's a bit stiff, so I have to push it with my fingers first to dispense the product.
This makes an instant difference. Makes me look awake without having a morning coffee!

avis.titre: Tired mom - you would never know it!
avis.texte: This product is an immediate wow! I'm a tired mom of a newborn - little sleep, and wanting to feel like "me" again. After ONE usage, I saw results! I've been using it for a solid week, and it's consistently good smelling, nice feeling, and results generating. The skin around my eyes looks smoother and less TIRED! I received this as a sample and I'm planning on purchasing it after just a few days of usage.
Love this product! Love the packaging and the applicator, so easy and convenient. Product is amazing. Instantly makes my eyes look smooth and awake. Would definitely buy!

I've been using this product for about a week now and so far I'm happy with the results. I've always had baggy dark circles and sunken under eyes. I have seen a difference so far of the plumpness under my eyes. I'm excited to use it longer and see how it improves more. My only nitpick would be the ceramic tip applicator. I don't love how it blends the product, I prefer to use my fingers to rub it in throughly. The amount of product you get for the price is a good value. Overall, I would say it's worth giving it a try!

avis.titre: This is the best eye cream for mature skin.
avis.texte: I just received my eye gel. I LOVE how it feels going on and the moisture makes my eyes look better than they have in a decade! I'm 60 years old and I will be buying this product again and again. I have lots of eye creams and this is my favorite!
I love the application. Super easy to use and sanitary! Love the ingredients as well.

I love the consistency of this serum! Gives great hydration without being thick or greasy. I have used this product at night and in the morning before applying makeup. It never pills and works well with other serums and sunscreen. I love the cooling and de-puffing effect that you get. I would purchase this again. I received this product for free in exchange for an honest review.

I genuinely liked this product! The application process took some time to get used to, but overall I'd continue using it. The applicator was cool and soothing while the actual gel/cream had a very light fragrance. It had a hint of eucalyptus - a very spa-like aroma.
it was a good product and it didn't leave a single reaction! the applicator was smooth as promised and th e

I love the Aqua Bomb Lifting Eye Gel! The cooling ceramic applicator feels amazing and instantly refreshes tired eyes. It's lightweight, hydrating, and absorbs quickly without leaving any residue. I'd definitely buy this again and recommend it to friends and family!

I LOVE the ceramic tip of this eye cream. It's cool not shockingly cold. I find the metal tips can be too much for this sensitive area. The cream itself has a pleasant yet subtle smell to it. Extremely cooling. I do not feel like I need to use my fingers to blend this in - the applicator works just fine. It also allows for a very precise application given its around the eye area. I have used this product for several days and none has made its way into my eye - zero irritation. The cream is moisturizing yet not occlusive so I am not concerned about milia. It is honestly perfect for before makeup or at night. I've used at both times of the day. I would absolutely purchase this product again and again. I love it!
I love the applicator. It's easy to use. There is also a lot of product. The product itself self works very well. I was impressed and pleased.
I have been using this for about two weeks and I have not noticed any difference whatsoever. Just to use it up I am still using it but when it's finished I will not buy again.

I received this product for free in exchange for writing this review and let me tell you- it did not disappoint! First off- the packaging of this is lovely. It's lightweight and skinny so you can fit it in a purse or travel effortlessly with it. I love the applicator on this product. I can tell the cream won't spill/leak out and it makes it very easy to apply it to specific areas under your eye. I love the texture of the cream as it's not to heavy or greasy. It feels very lightweight on my skin and absorbs nicely. I would buy this product on my own in the future!
This is a neat way to apply eye cream. I saw results within 10 mins of using this. It's very easy to use.

I love this applicator of eye gel. It's very hydrating and super easy to use. I love how you don't have to use your finger to apply. It definitely is a great eye gel. I don't have dark circles so I don't know how it would work, but I love how hydrating it is.

It does its job nice and lifts your eyes. Only down side is the application of it. It doesn't spread nicely with the applicator since it's more gel than liquid so you might need to touch it up using your fingers.
